purpose.zh: 练前腿的大腿和臀部，提升单腿力量
purpose.en: Build the front leg’s thigh and glutes for single-leg strength.

text.zh: 身体垂直往下沉，前膝对着脚尖
text.en: Lower straight down and keep your front knee over your toes

text.zh: 后脚脚背搭在椅面，前脚跟踩稳。
text.en: Rest the top of your back foot on the seat and keep your front heel down.

text.zh: 下到前大腿差不多和地面平，再用前脚跟推起。
text.en: Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, then push up through your front heel.

commonErrors.en: Letting your front knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不舒服时蹲浅一点
cautions.en: If your knee feels uncomfortable, do not go as low.

cautions.zh: 用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.

changes: 节奏按 spec 关键帧手算：底部只停 0.3 s（派生算成 0.9 s），kind rep_updown
顶点口令「稳住」改「到底」；注意改短句
